definition: fast and in very little time
description: A pit stop at a motor race under a cloudy sky. A young woman in a black and teal team suit and helmet kneels by the front wheel of a racing car, pressing a wheel gun onto it as sparks and smoke fly. Next to her another crew member holds an old tyre, a mechanic holds up a round stop sign, and wheel nuts lie scattered on the asphalt. When she is done she raises one arm high. Team members lean over the pit wall above, shouting and pointing.
